title: Open-source model matches frontier performance on coding benchmarks
summary: A new openly licensed model posts benchmark scores within a few points of the leading closed models on software engineering tasks, while running on a single consumer GPU.

title: EU publishes final guidance on AI transparency requirements
summary: The guidance clarifies what counts as an AI-generated content disclosure and gives companies a twelve-month runway to comply.

title: Researchers demonstrate room-temperature quantum memory lasting one hour
summary: A team stored quantum states in a doped crystal for over an hour without cryogenic cooling, a major step toward practical quantum networks.

title: Ocean survey finds coral recovery in protected reef zones
summary: A five-year survey shows coral cover increasing 18% in no-fishing zones, the strongest evidence yet that local protections buy time against warming.

title: Chipmaker announces 30% efficiency gain in next-gen mobile processors
summary: The new architecture promises a full extra day of phone battery life, with first devices expected early next year.

title: Major browser ships built-in tracker blocking by default
summary: The change affects roughly a billion users and is expected to reshape how ad networks measure campaigns.

title: Global markets steady as inflation cools for third straight month
summary: Consumer prices rose at the slowest pace in two years, raising expectations that central banks will hold rates steady through autumn.

title: Trial shows once-weekly pill as effective as daily insulin for type 2 diabetes
summary: In a phase 3 trial of 3,000 patients, the oral drug controlled blood sugar as well as daily injections with fewer side effects.
